levels.title: In the Beginning
levels.intro: Before anything was, God was. He spoke, and light broke through the dark.

levels.title: The Fall
levels.intro: A serpent, a question, and a bite that changed everything.

levels.title: Noah to Abram
levels.intro: The world grew wicked, but Noah found favor. After the flood, God called a man named Abram.

levels.title: Father of Many
levels.intro: Count the stars, God told Abram. So shall your offspring be.

levels.title: The Promised Son
levels.intro: On Mount Moriah, a father and son climbed together. God would provide.

levels.title: Jacob the Wrestler
levels.intro: A stolen blessing, a ladder to heaven, and a wrestling match with God.

levels.title: Joseph the Dreamer
levels.intro: Sold by his brothers, jailed in Egypt, but God was with Joseph.

levels.title: Joseph's Family
levels.intro: You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.

levels.title: The Trials of Job
levels.intro: A blameless man loses everything, and still he will not curse God.

levels.title: The Burning Bush
levels.intro: Israel cried out in slavery. In the desert, a bush burned but was not consumed.

levels.title: Let My People Go
levels.intro: Ten plagues, one hard heart, and the blood of a lamb on the doorposts.

levels.title: The Red Sea
levels.intro: Pharaoh's army thundered behind them. Moses raised his staff...

levels.title: Mount Sinai
levels.intro: Thunder, smoke, and the voice of God giving His people ten words.

levels.title: The Book of the Covenant
levels.intro: God gave Moses laws for living and plans for a tent where He would dwell.

levels.title: The Golden Calf
levels.intro: While Moses was on the mountain, the people made a god of gold.

levels.title: The Tabernacle
levels.intro: Every willing heart gave, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

levels.title: Counted and Camped
levels.intro: Twelve tribes, counted and camped around the presence of God.

levels.title: The Twelve Spies
levels.intro: Ten spies saw giants. Two saw God's promise.

levels.title: Rebellion in the Desert
levels.intro: Korah rebelled, water flowed from a rock, and a bronze serpent brought healing.

levels.title: Balaam's Donkey
levels.intro: A king hired a prophet to curse Israel, but even his donkey knew better.

levels.title: A New Generation
levels.intro: Forty years passed. A new generation stood at the edge of the Promised Land.

levels.title: Remember the Way
levels.intro: Hear, O Israel: the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

levels.title: Statutes and Rules
levels.intro: Moses taught the people how to live in the land God was giving them.

levels.title: Choose Life
levels.intro: Blessings and curses, a final song, and Moses climbs Mount Nebo.

levels.title: The Walls of Jericho
levels.intro: Be strong and courageous. Then march, shout, and watch the walls fall.

levels.title: Taking the Land
levels.intro: Sin in the camp, the sun stands still, and city after city falls.

levels.title: As for Me and My House
levels.intro: The land was divided, and Joshua made his choice: we will serve the Lord.

levels.title: Deborah
levels.intro: Israel forgot God again and again. Then a judge named Deborah arose.

levels.title: Gideon's Three Hundred
levels.intro: The least in his family, and God called him a mighty man of valor.

levels.title: Dark Days
levels.intro: Kings who weren't kings and vows that should never have been made.

levels.title: Samson
levels.intro: The strongest man alive, and his weakness was his heart.

levels.title: No King in Israel
levels.intro: Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.

levels.title: Offerings and Priests
levels.intro: How can sinful people come near a holy God? Through sacrifice.

levels.title: Clean and Unclean
levels.intro: Once a year, the high priest entered the Most Holy Place for the Day of Atonement.

levels.title: Be Holy
levels.intro: You shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy.

levels.title: Ruth
levels.intro: Where you go I will go, and your God will be my God.

levels.title: Speak, Lord
levels.intro: A barren woman prayed, and God answered with a boy named Samuel.

levels.title: Saul the First King
levels.intro: Israel wanted a king like the nations. They got one: tall, handsome, and disobedient.

levels.title: David and Goliath
levels.intro: The Lord looks at the heart. A shepherd boy faces a giant.

levels.title: David on the Run
levels.intro: Anointed but hunted, David hid in caves and spared his enemy's life.

levels.title: King David
levels.intro: David became king, danced before the ark, and received an everlasting promise.

levels.title: David's Sin
levels.intro: A rooftop, a lie, and a prophet saying: You are the man.

levels.title: Absalom
levels.intro: David's own son turned against him. O Absalom, my son, my son!

levels.title: Solomon's Wisdom
levels.intro: Ask what I shall give you, God said. Solomon asked for wisdom.

levels.title: A Kingdom Divided
levels.intro: One kingdom split in two, and golden calves returned.

levels.title: Elijah
levels.intro: Fire from heaven on Mount Carmel, then a still, small voice.

levels.title: Elisha
levels.intro: A chariot of fire, a double portion, and miracles from oil to healing.

levels.title: Kings of Israel and Judah
levels.intro: Jehu's wild chariot ride, and king after king who did evil in God's sight.

levels.title: Hezekiah and Josiah
levels.intro: Two good kings who trusted God and found His forgotten Book.

levels.title: The Family Tree
levels.intro: From Adam to the exiles: every name is part of God's story.

levels.title: David's Reign Remembered
levels.intro: David gathered the gold and the plans so his son could build God's temple.

areas.title: Exile and Return
areas.note: No prophecy, and only the fall of Israel.

levels.title: Return and Rebuild
levels.intro: King Cyrus let God's people go home, and they rebuilt the temple.

levels.title: Ezra the Scribe
levels.intro: Ezra set his heart to study, do, and teach God's law.

levels.title: Rebuilding the Walls
levels.intro: A trowel in one hand, a sword in the other. The wall was done in 52 days.

levels.title: The Joy of the Lord
levels.intro: The people wept as the law was read. Do not grieve, for the joy of the Lord is your strength.

levels.title: For Such a Time as This
levels.intro: An orphan became queen, and her courage saved her people.

levels.title: Ezekiel by the River
levels.intro: Among the exiles by the river Chebar, the heavens opened.

levels.title: Daniel in Babylon
levels.intro: Vegetables, a dream of a statue, and three friends in a fiery furnace.

levels.title: The Lions' Den
levels.intro: Writing on the wall, and a night with the lions.

levels.title: Jerusalem Falls
levels.intro: God sent messengers again and again, until there was no remedy.

levels.title: The Fall of Israel
levels.intro: Samaria fell to Assyria, and then Jerusalem to Babylon.

levels.title: The King Is Born
levels.intro: Wise men followed a star to find the newborn King of the Jews.

levels.title: The Sermon on the Mount
levels.intro: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

levels.title: Follow Me
levels.intro: Storms stilled, crowds fed, and twelve ordinary men called.

levels.title: He Is Risen
levels.intro: Palm branches, a cross, and an empty tomb. Go and make disciples.

levels.title: The Servant
levels.intro: Immediately! Jesus heals, teaches, and asks: Who do you say that I am?

levels.title: A Ransom for Many
levels.intro: The Son of Man came not to be served but to serve.

levels.title: Good News of Great Joy
levels.intro: Shepherds, angels, and a baby lying in a manger.

levels.title: Today This Is Fulfilled
levels.intro: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, to proclaim good news to the poor.

levels.title: Lost and Found
levels.intro: A good Samaritan, a lost sheep, and a prodigal son running home.

levels.title: The Road to Emmaus
levels.intro: Did not our hearts burn within us while He talked with us on the road?

levels.title: The Word Became Flesh
levels.intro: In the beginning was the Word. Water became wine, and a woman met Him at a well.

levels.title: I Am
levels.intro: The Bread of Life, the Light of the World, the Resurrection and the Life.

levels.title: The Upper Room
levels.intro: He washed their feet and said: I am the way, the truth, and the life.

levels.title: It Is Finished
levels.intro: A cross, a garden tomb, and breakfast on the beach.

levels.title: Pentecost
levels.intro: Tongues of fire, three thousand saved, and the church is born.

levels.title: To Samaria and Beyond
levels.intro: A persecutor named Saul met Jesus on the road to Damascus.

levels.title: Paul's Journeys
levels.intro: Ships, shipwrecks-to-be, and churches planted across the world.

levels.title: All the Way to Rome
levels.intro: Arrested, shipwrecked, and still preaching boldly in Rome.
